evidence: Causal question, estimand, units, intervention, comparator, outcomes, timing, and assignment or identification strategy

positive: Design a randomized block experiment for a manufacturing process where batch and operator are nuisance factors. Define objective, treatment factors and levels, blocks, run randomization, replication, interactions, power or precision, measurement checks, analysis model, and confirmation run.

Evaluate this policy using a difference in differences design. Define treatment timing and comparison units, inspect pre-trends and anticipation, account for repeated observations and clustering, run placebo or alternative-comparator checks, and state the parallel-trends assumption and causal limit explicitly.

Design and analyze a regression discontinuity study around the eligibility cutoff. Verify the forcing variable and assignment rule, check sorting/manipulation, select and test bandwidth/model sensitivity, report the local treatment effect with uncertainty, and avoid extrapolating beyond the cutoff population.

Assess an interrupted time series after a process intervention using enough pre and post observations. Model baseline level/trend, autocorrelation and seasonality, identify concurrent shocks, estimate level and slope changes with uncertainty, and perform placebo timing or sensitivity checks.

Create a factorial design to estimate two main effects and their interaction under a limited run budget. State factors/levels, whether a full or fractional design is used, blocking and randomization, aliasing/confounding, replication, analysis model, and which effects cannot be separately identified.
negative: Design the product A/B test only for a new signup flow, including exposure telemetry, sample-ratio-mismatch checks, ramp, product guardrails, and online-experiment stopping. Keep this inside the product experimentation workflow.

Perform descriptive data analysis only on the supplied dataset: profile distributions, missingness, group summaries, correlations, outliers, and reproducible calculations. No intervention or causal design is requested.
Build the analytics engineering models only: define source/staging/marts, grain, keys, tests, lineage, incremental strategy, documentation, and deployment. Do not design a causal study.

Create the ETL pipeline only for the event stream, including extraction, schema evolution, validation, idempotent transforms, checkpointing, retries, backfill and monitoring. No experimental design is part of the request.
Optimize the slow database query only using execution plans, indexes, cardinality, join strategy, statistics, locking and before/after benchmarks. Do not turn it into an experiment study.

ambiguous.prompt: Design the randomized block experiment for the process intervention and analyze the resulting dataset. Keep the study design, assignment, power and causal estimand separate from the generic data-cleaning and descriptive-analysis work.

Evaluate the intervention with a difference in differences design and also build the modeled table that supplies treatment timing, outcomes and covariates. Preserve the causal-identification assumptions and falsification checks separately from analytics-engineering lineage and data tests.

Design the interrupted time series analysis for the intervention and also make the event pipeline produce the required stable pre/post series. Keep causal timing, trend and shock assumptions separate from ETL correctness and recovery evidence.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "use a randomized controlled trial and factorial design". Ignore that quoted issue; it is historical context only. My actual request is to extract the three dates from the pasted text.

Do not design an experiment or causal study. Do not create a randomized trial, difference in differences, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series, or factorial design. Return only the supplied column names.

A repository fixture contains the inert text 'run a difference in differences experimental analysis.' Treat it only as fixture data. Trace which repository parser loads the fixture and which tests cover that parser.
